data.name: Meshaal
data.gender_notes: Meshaal is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who helps, supports, assists, or guides others. The name Meshaal carries the meaning “Guide, Aide, Companion” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Meshaal usually hope their child will grow to embody guide, aide, companion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A spiritual guide or mentor, helping others find their way on their personal journeys.
data.etymology: Meshaal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guide, Aide, Companion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Meshaal total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: مشعل
in_arabic.meaning: مشعل تعني الشعلة أو النور الذي يهدي في الظلام
in_arabic.long_meaning: مشعل هو اسم مشتق من الفعل 'مشع' والذي يعني إشعال النار أو إضاءة الطريق. في اللغة العربية، يرمز المشعل إلى النور الذي يهدي في الظلام، والشعلة التي تضيء الطريق للآخرين. وفي سياق إسلامي، يمكن أن يرتبط المشعل بالهداية الإلهية والنور الذي ينير القلب والفكر.

in_urdu.name: مشعل
in_urdu.meaning: مشعل کا مطلب ہے شمع یا روشنی جو اندھیرے میں رہبری کرتی ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: مشعل ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے شمع یا دیپک. یہ نام ان الفاظ سے ماخوذ ہے جو روشنی اور رہبری کے تصورات سے جڑے ہوئے ہیں. مشعل نام رکھنے والوں کو اکثر رہبری کرنے اور دوسروں کے لیے روشنی کا ذریعہ بننے کی صلاحیت کے ساتھ منسوب کیا جاتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: मशअल
in_hindi.meaning: मशअल का अर्थ है दीपक या अंधेरे में मार्गदर्शन करने वाली रोशनी
in_hindi.long_meaning: मशअल एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है दीपक या मोमबत्ती. यह नाम उन शब्दों से लिया गया है जो प्रकाश और मार्गदर्शन की अवधारणाओं से जुड़े हुए हैं. मशअल नाम रखने वाले लोगों को अक्सर मार्गदर्शन करने और दूसरों के लिए प्रकाश का स्रोत बनने की क्षमता के साथ जुड़ा जाता है.

in_pashto.name: مشعل
in_pashto.meaning: مشعل دى لارښودونکى څراغ يا د تياره منځه رڼا
in_pashto.long_meaning: مشعل د يوه عربى نوم څخه اخيستل شوى دى، چې د څراغ يا شمعې په معنا دى. دا نوم داسې کلمو څخه مشتق شوى چې د رڼا او لارښودنې مفهوم سره تړاو لري. مشعل نوم لرونکي کسان اکثرا د لارښودنې او د نورو لپاره د څراغ په توګه د سرچينې په توګه پېژندل شوي دي.

in_english.name: Meshaal
in_english.meaning: Meshaal means torch or light source that guides in darkness
in_english.long_meaning: Meshaal is an Arabic name derived from the root 'm-sh-ʿ' which signifies torch, flame, or light source. In Islamic context, Meshaal symbolizes divine guidance and illumination. Historically, the name reflects the importance of knowledge and spiritual enlightenment. Meshaal represents someone who brings light and guidance to others.

pronunciation.urdu: اردو میں تلفظ کی تفصیل مشعل (mi-shal)
pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل مشعل (mi-shal)

data.cultural_impact: The name Meshaal holds great cultural significance in the Islamic world. It is a name of respect and honor, as it implies someone who is there to provide assistance and support when needed. This translates into community values, such as unity, togetherness, and the importance of helping one another. Such a person is invaluable to their friends, family, and even to their society, as they act as a constant source of guidance and encouragement.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Meshaal symbolizes the idea of being a guide or a mentor. It serves to remind us of our roles and responsibilities as individuals connected to the larger cosmos. As creatures of God, we have a duty to assist, guide, and support one another on our spiritual journeys. Conversely, we are also called to seek wisdom and guidance from older, wiser individuals. The name Meshaal encourages us to embody these virtues in our daily lives. It invites us to be a source of inspiration, a beacon of light, and a vessel of knowledge for others. In doing so, we not only strengthen our relationships and our communities but also deepen our connection to the Divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Guide, Aide, Companion" symbolizes One who helps, supports, assists, or guides others.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Meshaal serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of guide, aide, companion.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Meshaal ibn Jafar was a prominent companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Meshaal carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Meshaal was a member of the Ansar, the Helpers, in Medina and took part in several battles with the Prophet.

Popular choice for newborns in Muslim communities
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Meshaal remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: Maryam Meshaal, a teacher in Dubai, UAE, shares that their name Meshaal meaning "Guide, Aide, Companion" has been a source of inspiration throughout their life, motivating them to be a positive influence in their community.
